name: Solid Glass
works_with: shadcn/ui projects on React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4
short: A glass-look stylesheet for shadcn/ui, plus components for agent apps such as a status line, composer, tool steps and diff view.
what: Solid Glass is one stylesheet that restyles shadcn/ui components into a frosted, solid glass look with fine borders and soft shadows. It finds each component part by the `data-slot` and classes shadcn already uses, so your existing components need no changes. It also ships its own components for AI interfaces: a status glyph, turn status, composer, tool steps, diff view, ask card, context ring, task notice and reasoning panel.
who: Front-end developers building an AI chat or agent app on shadcn/ui. Skip it if you are not on shadcn/ui with React 19 and Tailwind 4.
needs: A shadcn/ui project with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4 and the Base UI components

steps.title: Import it
steps.text: Import it after Tailwind and shadcn's stylesheet. Then delete the `:root` and `.dark` colour variables that `shadcn init` wrote, because Solid Glass defines the same names.

steps.title: Add its own components
steps.text: Each one installs the same way.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Add `status-glyph`, the three points of light that show a turn is running and what it is doing, then open the Create page on the project site to try the thickness, tint and blur settings.

watch: You have to delete the colour variables `shadcn init` wrote, or the two sets will clash.
Dark is the theme as designed. Light is included too.
The `add` commands pull files from this GitHub repo straight into your project.
